rationale.oversight-theater: Outcome-only review backfires because reviewers lack visibility into AI use.
rationale.automation-bias: Expected review increases deference to AI expertise and unmodified acceptance.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Showing original AI output beside submissions restores modification under review.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Authors recommend submitting persistent AI interaction logs alongside final work.
rationale.counterpoint: Challenges the prevailing assumption that review increases effort and accountability.
